stemMd: Of 80 students, 50 study chemistry, 40 study biology and 25 study both. A student is selected at random from those studying biology. What is the probability that the student also studies chemistry?
explanationMd: Conditioning on biology restricts the sample space to 40 students. Of these, 25 also study chemistry, giving 25/40=5/8. The 80-student total is no longer the denominator.

distractorRationale.c: This uses the biology fraction of the whole cohort.
distractorRationale.e: This is not the conditional denominator in the stem.
distractorRationale.a: This divides by all students rather than biology students.
distractorRationale.b: This is the probability of not studying chemistry among biology students.
